title: One shared memory across Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini (Hindsight)
description: One memory across Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, and every AI tool you touch. No more exporting and reimporting, no more being trapped in each app native memory. It runs on Hindsight, a cloud hosted memory database with an MCP server, so you point Claude, ChatGPT, the Gemini app, Claude Code, anything that speaks MCP at the same brain. Three tools, retain to store, recall to pull, reflect to actually synthesize across everything you have saved. This is the cleanest fix I have seen for memory living in ten different silos. Comment memory and I will send you the link.
